WITH distinct_transactions AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, tr.transreg
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
counts_by_type AS (
  SELECT tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) as count_
  FROM distinct_transactions
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(count_ * 1.0) as avg_count,
    SUM(count_) as total_count
  FROM counts_by_type
),
with_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    cb.tradekind,
    cb.count_,
    cb.count_ * 1.0 / s.total_count as share,
    s.avg_count
  FROM counts_by_type cb
  CROSS JOIN stats s
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    count_, share, avg_count,
    count_ - avg_count as excess
  FROM with_metrics
  WHERE count_ > avg_count
)
SELECT 
  SUM(count_) as sum_counts,
  AVG(share) as avg_shares,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM filtered
